title: Unit: access, shared devices, and your active crew
audience: Crews using an apparatus tablet, vehicle device, or shared operational workstation.
summary: Sign in as an accountable person, select the correct apparatus, organize its crew, and understand shared-session and security controls.
prerequisites: A training member assigned to the station group that owns a demonstration unit; configured roles and unit statuses.
A shared-session policy and verification methods for the optional shared-device branch.
SSO, passkeys, and MFA only where actually configured; native hardware for operating-system permission captures.

Preserve Engine51 unit role51001 Officer/TeamLead = Christopher Herrmann only. The other five units remain unassigned; do not change member status, shift assignments or qualifications for this crew example.

scenes.title: Understand the person and the apparatus
scenes.capture_intent: Show actual authenticated apparatus context and Settings after private ordinary sign-in. The app does not display the operator name in this view; never label the apparatus or assigned crew as the signed-in operator.
scenes.narration: Unit follows the apparatus context selected on this device, while a named person signs in. Identify both before working. The active unit scopes status, roles, map context, routes, and inventory; review it in Settings at each handoff. This is useful for a SAR vehicle, community response team, or industrial standby. A vehicle-mounted tablet still needs the correct member and apparatus selection.
scenes.practice: Identify the signed-in training member and the apparatus the tablet is intended to represent before changing any operational data.

source_workflow_reference.title: Understand the person and the apparatus
source_workflow_reference.narration: Unit follows the apparatus or crew context selected on this device, while a person still signs in with their own account. Start by identifying both. The active unit determines relevant status, roles, map context, routes, and inventory. Settings is where you review that selection. A tablet mounted in a vehicle does not remove individual accountability, and it does not automatically select the right apparatus for today’s crew.

scenes.capture_intent: 006 shows real installation toggle, fictional label and Save;007 shows the saved label. The local setting is separate from server-supported shared-session policy.

source_workflow_reference.title: Practice lock and shift handoff
source_workflow_reference.narration: After a supported Shared device sign-in, inspect the session bar and its Lock control. Idle or background behavior follows policy; Stay signed in may appear near an idle deadline. Unlock with the verification method permitted for the current member, or use End shift and Switch operator for a handoff. Check the resulting account and session state before resuming work. Enabling a setup toggle differs from verifying the device’s actual lock behavior.

source_workflow_reference.title: Assign the actual crew roles
source_workflow_reference.narration: Open the roles card and inspect Unit Role Assignments. Choose the appropriate person for each configured seat or role, then Save when the roster matches the actual training crew. A role assignment describes who fills that apparatus function; it does not replace account permissions or a dated shift sign-up. Review the assignments again after a crew change so the displayed resource picture remains useful.

source_workflow_reference.title: Keep account security and recovery visible
source_workflow_reference.narration: Settings provides Sign-in and security for the person using Unit. Review the authenticator state, passkeys, and Recent verifications. Add a passkey only for an authorized account and supported platform. Login info helps confirm identity, and Logout supports a clean handoff. Lost-factor recovery can replace an authenticator and end sessions, so practice on a disposable account. Responder approval is a separate flow whose result should be checked on the requesting device.

capture_limitations: Organization SSO discovery/callback, additional MFA verification, passkey/authenticator enrollment/recovery and sign-out are unexercised; no credential or policy changes.

This installation label and normal Sign In boundary do not establish stable server shared-session Lock, unlock, operator switching, countdown, Stay signed in or End shift behavior. Those remain required follow-up app-coverage branches when legitimately offered.
Ordinary Submit is recorded. Configured hold/next-state restrictions remain separate follow-up scenarios; no hidden-store/serverflag/security edits.
Directions native/external handoff and Deselect confirmation/result are unexercised; actual icon controls are visible with reviewed browser DOM semantics only.
No device GPS/location permission, physical mobilization/readiness, camera/microphone/Bluetooth, native background behavior or external provider operation is claimed.
